title: General CRC Syndrome Detector
text: Detect errors in received codeword frames according to generator polynomial, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Final XOR} sets Final XOR; {Generator polynomial}, {Initial states}, {Direct method} uses direct algorithm for CRC checksum, {Reflect input bytes}, {Reflect checksums before final XOR} and {Checksums per frame} sets the number of checksums calculated for each. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Err
ports.summary: Checksum error signal binary column vector

params.name: Generator polynomial
params.values: Generator polynomial ’z^16 + z^12 + z^5 + 1’ (default) | polynomial character vector | binary row vector | integer row vector

params.name: Initial states
params.values: Initial states of internal shift register 0 (default) | 1 | binary row vector

params.name: Direct method
params.values: Use direct algorithm for CRC checksum calculations off (default) | on

params.name: Reflect checksums before final XOR
params.values: Reflect checksums before final XOR off (default) | on

params.name: Checksums per frame
params.values: Number of checksums calculated for each frame 1 (default) | positive integer
